items.stem: What is the main advantage of a function that uses 'return' rather than only printing?

options.text: The returned value can be reused elsewhere in the program, not just displayed
options.rationale: Correct: returning a value lets other code use the result.

options.text: return makes the program run without a computer
options.rationale: Code still needs a computer; return just passes a value back.

options.text: Printing and returning are exactly the same
options.rationale: Printing shows text; returning hands back a usable value.
return provides a result; it does not delete the function.

items.explanation: Correct: returning a value lets other code use the result.

items.stem: Which TWO situations are good reasons to use a dictionary instead of a list? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Looking up a student's score by their name
options.rationale: Correct: dictionaries map keys (names) to values (scores).

options.text: Storing settings as labelled key/value pairs
options.rationale: Correct: dictionaries are ideal for labelled values.

options.text: Keeping a simple ordered sequence of numbers to total
options.rationale: A plain ordered sequence is better suited to a list.

options.text: Repeating one action a fixed number of times
options.rationale: That is a loop concern, not a reason for a dictionary.

items.explanation: Correct: dictionaries map keys (names) to values (scores).

items.stem: Your program crashes when a data file is missing. What is the best way to handle this?

options.text: Wrap the file access in try/except and give a helpful message if the file is missing
options.rationale: Correct: error handling lets the program respond gracefully.

options.text: Assume the file is always there
options.rationale: Files can be missing; the program should handle it.

options.text: Delete the part of the program that reads files
options.rationale: The program needs to read the file; handle the error instead.
Graceful handling is better than crashing.

items.explanation: Correct: error handling lets the program respond gracefully.
